title: Online ordering
summary: A cafe takes pickup orders with options, test checkout and a live kitchen board.

entryPoints.summary: Browse the public menu and choose a pickup slot.
Sign in or create a customer account.
Follow an order through a private signed link.
Move paid orders through their statuses.
Edit the menu, slots, staff and statuses; import and export CSV.

owner.summary: Manages menu, hours, capacity, statuses and staff.

kitchen.summary: Signs in to the order board only.

customer.summary: Signs in with the starter member role and sees only their own orders.

visitor.summary: Browses and orders as a guest, following a signed order link.

journeys.summary: Browse the menu and opening hours.
Edit categories, items, options and choices.
Manage opening hours and pickup slot capacity.
Edit order statuses and keep values in use.
Add a staff account with kitchen-only access.
Open owner settings through a one-time owner pass.
Create an account and see only your own orders.
A signed-out visitor sees no order list.
A guest orders with options and pays through a test checkout.
The signed order page shows a paid order move to Ready.
Import and export the menu including options and choices.

notIncluded: Payments require the platform capability door connected to a test account, and PRAMAAN_PAYMENTS_MODE=test; no live payments.
Email and files modules are off by default.
Currency is GBP; opening hours and pickup slots use UTC.
Pending or ambiguous checkouts hold capacity conservatively; automatic expiry and abandoned-checkout reconciliation are not included.
No delivery, refunds, taxes, discounts or inventory counts; sold-out flags are owner controlled.
Customer accounts use the starter member role. Guest orders are not automatically attached to later signups.
Status links expire after seven days.
Menu CSV imports at most 100 rows and 12,000 characters per batch, updating by names; photo files are separate.
Staff accounts use owner-set passwords; password reset and staff removal are not included.
